decisionSummary: Do not write customer posting, general business posting, VAT business posting or payment term values yet. U-CUST-100 has realistic identity/address evidence, but the setup-dependent billing/payment fields need a setup-dependency read-first proof with stronger screenshot QA before a narrow write gate.

officialSourceReferences.topic: Posting groups map customers, vendors, items and documents to G/L accounts; general posting setup combines business and product groups.
VAT/GST business and product posting groups determine tax calculation and can be defaulted from general business/product groups or templates.
Payment methods can be assigned to customers/vendors, but remain a separate payment-process decision.
Payment terms carry code, display name and due-date calculation logic.
